decision: Do not port the full compact mixer/cache by default in this optimization pass. Prefer isolated existing nonstream bypass next.
fit_comparison_limit: Different full builds, optimization modes and placement. Not a controlled estimate of os20/os25 savings.
default_sdk_benefit: None from cache: firmware writes MIX_CTRL=1; cache reset/default OFF and no SDK capability/enable calls.

cache_contract.invalidation: Each voice-register write invalidates that voice; disable clears validity
cache_contract.coherence: No CPU-store snooping. Every nonstream sample must remain immutable while playing if global cache enabled.
cache_contract.bypass_latency: Adapter still has IDLE/BYPASS_AR/BYPASS_R stages; cache-off preserves payloads, not literal wire timing.

workloads.Diablo: Decoded mono hardware SFX with owned PCM and stop-before-free; promising explicit per-app opt-in after complete lifecycle audit, not automatic current behavior.
workloads.ScummVM: Software SFX/speech/music mix goes through one mutable stereo stream, which must bypass. MIDI sample-bank voices could benefit with proven immutable-bank lifetimes; cache does not remove software mixing CPU work.
workloads.MIDI: Volume/rate/loop field writes invalidate voice lines frequently. Full32/rates/groups/ramping/W1C/stream semantics retained by bounded prior tests, not a generic-core capacity/timing proof.

prior_proof_limits: 177 inherited checks,18432 model samples/96scenarios and capacity343rows cover compact candidate function, not formal equivalence.
Compact FSM reschedules table reads and position arithmetic; same-cycle claims in compact-v4-reuse refer to V4, not current generic mixer.
Cache-enabled52case sustained synthetic qualification is Quake2-specific; adverse32voice stereo/high-rate cases still underrun.
No os20/os25 physical fit or app-side coherent enable policy established.
next_small_candidate: Current generic INCLUDE_NONSTREAM_BYPASS skips two backlog states only for nonstream voices; no samplecache/coherence dependency. Parent authorized isolated proof now.
